title: How Strong Is the Sun on a Boat in Madeira?
description: Madeira's midday UV index is about 8 to 10 from April to August and around 3 in winter. On a boat the breeze hides the burn. UV by month and how to protect.
heroAlt: The sharp line between canopy shade and hard sun across a boat deck
keywords: how strong is the sun on a boat in Madeira
best time of day for a boat trip sun
